notes.title: Letters to Arralla Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Ahoy! We have some super exciting news to share with you. Letters to Arralla now has a release date! And that date is....

... Here in this release date trailer!
[previewyoutube="3fAsQ731Zt0;full"][/previewyoutube]
🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉


We'll also say it here though, the release date for Letters to Arralla is...


September 16th, 2025!!!


It's been almost exactly 5 years since we first began this project, and now we are gearing up to launch it directly into the sun (and by the sun, we mean Steam)!

Thank you so much for joining us on this journey, we can't wait for you to play our cheeky and cheeked-up game. If you haven't yet (and if you'd like to), please wishlist Letters to Arralla to stay in the loop on when the game drops! Happy deliveries!
